text:
ops-runbot: :rotating_light: PAGE: nova-corp (VPC, dedicated pool gamma) experiencing increased toolcall parser failures — ~12% error rate, first spike at 12:03 UTC. Auto-escalating to on-call.

maya: oncall (maya) here, I'm looking. Can someone paste the error samples?

sam: grabbing logs from pool gamma. initial grep shows `parser:toolcall` exceptions referencing `expected string, got object` in parse step. pulling last 10m.

eli: quick context — we rolled parser v2.14 in gamma at 10:45 UTC with the new schema that expects `tool.inputs` as stringified JSON. Some customers send structured JSON and the strict parser fails. nova-corp reported today after high traffic job.

harper: support saw the customer app return 500s. They forwarded this snippet from their side:

support-bot: "response": { "error": "toolcall parse_failed", "details": "expected string, got object at input.payload" }

sam: logs from runtime:
```
2026-06-10T12:02:57Z ERROR parser.toolcall id=abcd1234 tenant=nova-corp pool=gamma err="json: cannot unmarshal object into Go value of type string"
2026-06-10T12:03:02Z WARN fallback: invoked plain_text_fallback for req=abcd1235 tenant=nova-corp
```

maya: impact assessment — current failures affect 12% of toolcall-heavy routes for nova-corp only. No cross-tenant impact observed. Dedicated pool gamma isolated but parser change was global in the pool.

eli: immediate mitigation options:
- rollback parser on gamma to v2.13
- deploy compatibility shim that accepts object and string
- route nova-corp to pool delta (if capacity)

sam: delta is at 70% usage; can burst but prefer not to move traffic if rollback is quick. I can run rollback in ~5m.

maya: do it. Sam -> you're primary. Eli -> prepare a shim patch in case rollback doesn't resolve. Harper -> keep customer updated.

sam: running rollback command now:
```
redwoodctl pool update gamma --set parser_version=2.13 --reason "rollback after parser v2.14 caused nova-corp toolcall failures"
```

ops-runbot: Deploy job started: job=deploy-rollback-1865123456 user=sam pool=gamma

sam: rollback applied, controllers report pods cycling. rolling: 3/3 -> 3/3. health checks passing.

10m later

sam: checks: error rate for nova toolcall routes dropped from 12% -> 0.8%. Rolling average looks stable.

maya: confirm with support if customer still seeing 500s.

harper: on it. I messaged nova-corp SE: "We detected a parser rollback; could you retry the failing calls?" They replied: "Retry worked, thanks — we saw success on 3/3 attempts." :thumbsup:

eli: follow-ups:
- patch parser to accept both string and object (compat shim) targeted for v2.14.1
- add unit test for tool.inputs formats
- add canary routing for parser changes to limit cross-tenant blast radius

maya: sam, you'll hand off on-call after stabilization window. I'll open a post-incident note and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml for parser compat work.

sam: ack — I'll stay on for 30m then hand off to eli.

ops-runbot: Incident update: status=mitigated, mitigation=rollback parser on pool gamma, impact=tenant-specific, next=postmortem

maya: logging timeline + actions in incidents channel. Great job team. Closing page.

harper: closing comms with customer. they asked for a dedicated changelog email when v2.14.1 released.

eli: noted. I'll draft the patch and PR with tests. tagging eng-ml for review.

maya: thanks. :white_check_mark:
